papers.title: Sigmoid Self-Attention has Lower Sample Complexity than Softmax Self-Attention: A Mixture-of-Experts Perspective
findings: Whole-token concatenation is allowed; no within-sequence token independence requirement.
Unnormalized sigmoid quadratic-gating scalar Gaussian regression with least-squares, over-specified expert counts and identifiability-dependent parameter/expert targets.
Dense-case target includes a best over-specified approximation set, not an automatic task-risk/Macro-F1 bound for normalized Born classification.
limitations: Appendix proofs and numerical experiments were not independently verified; parsed snippets elsewhere are locators, not full reading.

papers.title: The effect of data encoding on the expressive power of variational quantum machine learning models
findings: Quantum expectations admit encoding-determined partial Fourier spectra; repeated encoding richness is established prior work.
General trainable blocks are arbitrary unitaries for the source analysis; a particular constrained circuit must be checked constructively.
limitations: Full universality and later sections/appendices were not independently verified. No direct task-learning or normalized-head comparison transferred.

reading_scope: Listed pages only; original source facts separate from target conjecture.
